title: Compact density mode and token-aware spacing for form inputs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: introduce a compact density mode for text fields/selects/toggles that reduces vertical rhythm and padding using token-aware spacing rules while preserving accessibility and clear validation affordances. Background: product teams request a denser form option for admin dashboards and settings screens to surface more fields per viewport. Current ad-hoc compact styles across apps cause inconsistent spacing, clipped truncation in selects, and reduced hit targets for touch. This ticket standardizes token mappings (spacing, hit area, typography scale) and defines behavioral rules for validation states, helper text wrapping, and icon alignment in compact mode.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens: new spacing tokens (--space-xxs, --space-xs-compact) are proposed and mapped to existing token scales; docs show migration guidance
All form components have compact variants documented in Figma and component library examples (text field, textarea, select, toggle, checkbox, radio)
Validation states remain visually prominent at compact density: error icon and message visible without overlap; error color meets 4.5:1 contrast for text and 3:1 for decorative icons per AA/AA Large
Touch targets for interactive elements do not fall below 32x32px for touch surfaces; keyboard focus outlines remain 2px and visible
Design handoff includes CSS variable names, expected computed sizes, and example snapshots for responsivity (desktop/tablet/mobile)
UX review sign-off from PM and Accessibility review complete
design_notes: Token approach: introduce compact spacing tokens that scale from base tokens, not hard-coded px values; prefer relative values for ease of runtime theming
Typography: compact mode uses existing type scale but reduces line-height by 8% only where it does not break clipping; any reduction applied must be opt-in per component
Icon alignment: icons (clear, dropdown chevron) align to baseline grid in compact mode using 16px icon asset with 4px internal hit padding
Validation treatment: place error icon at trailing edge and error text in a single line when possible; allow helper text to wrap to a second line but reserve a maximum of 2 lines for compact mode
Select behavior: in compact mode, option height reduced but virtualized lists use same hover/active spacing; ensure keyboard arrow target area preserved
Toggle/checkbox: reduce visual padding but keep visual track and thumb contrast; document when to prefer compact checkbox vs default
Trade-offs: denser spacing reduces scannability for long forms; recommend using compact in administrative screens not for primary flows with many novices
